title: BAM names four singles players including Zii Jia for Thomas Cup
desc: PETALING JAYA: There were no surprises as the Badminton Association of Malaysia (BAM) named four singles players, including Paris Olympics bronze medallist Lee Zii Jia, for the Thomas Cup in Horsens, Denmark from April 24-May 3.

title: Tanzania eyes cotton output recovery to 300,000 tonnes
desc: MWANZA: TANZANIA is eyeing a recovery in cotton production to 300,000 tonnes in the 2026/27 season after output rose to 222,057 tonnes in 2025/26 from a record low of 149,361 tonnes a year earlier. The target will be achieved across 17 cotton-growing regions nationwide. The projection was revealed in Mwanza by a Senior Agricultural Officer
